It does not identify retryable statuses or exceptions, attempt counting, backoff, jitter, timeout behavior, method safety, or whether retries inject or preserve an API-wide `Idempotency-Key`. Event `transaction_id` is a separate usage-deduplication identity and must not be generalized to billable-metric, customer, product, rate-card, rate, or contract creation.
